title: Printed Interconnects and Electrical Reliability
question: How much of the electrical variation between nominally identical stretchable traces originates in printed-film thickness?
teaser: Printed-film thickness helps explain resistance variation between stretchable interconnect traces.
role: First author on the accepted manuscript
mechanism: Printed-film thickness contributes to initial trace-to-trace resistance variation; deformation-related changes are analyzed separately.
approach: Compare film-thickness differences with electrical characterization across printed liquid-metal-particle traces.
evidence: Accepted manuscript record on thickness and trace-to-trace electrical variability; related stretchable-PCB project.
achievement: Distinguishes process-origin electrical variation from resistance changes during repeated deformation.
myContribution: First author on the accepted manuscript; participating researcher in the related industry project.
outcome: The accepted study frames printed-process uniformity as an electrical-reliability problem for stretchable interconnects.
